title: Reconciling the Instalments Still to Be Settled on a Granite Ridge Pass Account
content:
Where the refusals a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass account carries do not agree with the instalments that have fallen due on it, the number still to be settled is reconciled as follows.

**First.** Where the pass account carries more refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date than there are instalments that have fallen due and not been cleared, the instalments still to be settled are the instalments that have fallen due less the scheduled instalments the pass account shows as cleared, and never below zero. This is the case where an instalment was presented again or has since cleared, so that the refusals standing overstate what is owed.

**Second.** Where the pass account shows no scheduled instalment cleared at all and carries fewer refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date than there are instalments that have fallen due, the instalments still to be settled are every instalment that has fallen due.

**Otherwise.** In any other case the count is not reconciled by this rule.

### The reconciliation on hypothetical accounts

Each row assumes a schedule of 6 instalments and 4 instalments fallen due on the handling date.

| Scheduled instalments cleared | Refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date | Instalments still to be settled |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | 2 | 1, being 4 less 3 |
| 0 | 2 | 4, being every instalment that has fallen due |
| 2 | 1 | not reconciled by this rule |
| 4 | 1 | 0, the reconciled figure never falling below zero |

In the first row the refusals standing, 2, exceed the instalments fallen due and not cleared, which are 1, so the first condition is met and the reconciled figure is 1. In the third row the refusals standing, 1, do not exceed the 2 instalments fallen due and not cleared, and a scheduled instalment has cleared, so neither condition is met.
